questions.text: From: Jenny To: Lara Lara, Try www.deals4trains.com for some great ticket discounts. I remember you said you wanted to visit a few interesting cities in the UK. This might be a good way to do it! Jenny

options.label: A
options.text: suggest how Lara could do some sightseeing.

options.label: B
options.text: remind Lara that she needs to book some cheap train tickets.

options.label: C
options.text: invite Lara to visit some different places around the UK with her.

questions.explanation:
Jenny 推荐网址 “www.deals4trains.com” 并说 “this might be a good way to visit interesting cities”（这可能是游览城市的好方法），对应 A 选项 “suggest how to do sightseeing”（建议如何观光）。
B 选项 “remind to book tickets”（提醒订票）和 C 选项 “invite to visit with her”（邀请一起游览）均未提及。

questions.text: Sweet Memories Can you remember your candy store favourites? Lecture by historical expert: The unusual story behind candy! Everyone welcome!

options.label: A
options.text: People will be asked to discuss their favourite childhood sweets at the lecture.

options.label: B
options.text: The lecture will be about how sweet shops have changed over the last century.

options.label: C
options.text: The lecture will cover some surprising facts about sweets.

questions.explanation:
讲座主题是 “The unusual story behind candy”（糖果背后的不寻常故事），对应 C 选项 “cover surprising facts about sweets”（涵盖糖果的惊人事实）。
A 选项 “discuss favourite childhood sweets”（讨论童年最爱糖果）和 B 选项 “how sweet shops changed”（糖果店如何变化）均与原文 “unusual story” 不符。

questions.text: Dan, That wildlife book you borrowed from the library sounds perfect for my next project. Text me when you're going to return it, and I’ll go and take it out myself. Jack

options.label: A
options.text: Jack is asking Dan's opinion about whether a book is suitable for his project.

options.label: B
options.text: Jack wants Dan to let him know when a library book will be available.

options.label: C
options.text: Jack is recommending to Dan a useful library book he has recently borrowed.

questions.explanation:
Jack 说 “Text me when you're going to return it, and I’ll go and take it out”（你还书时告诉我，我去借），对应 B 选项 “wants Dan to let him know when the book is available”（想让 Dan 告知书何时可借）。
A 选项 “ask opinion about the book”（询问书是否适合）和 C 选项 “recommend the book”（推荐书）错误，Jack 只是想借 Dan 借过的书。

questions.text: Tomato sauce Store in cool, dry place. After opening, keep in fridge and use within six weeks, and not after date shown.

options.label: A
options.text: Eat the sauce a maximum of six weeks after you start using it.

options.label: B
options.text: Put the sauce in your refrigerator as soon as you bring it home.

options.label: C
options.text: Make a note of the date when you bought the sauce.

questions.explanation:
说明提到 “After opening, keep in fridge and use within six weeks”（开封后放冰箱，六周内用完），对应 A 选项 “eat within six weeks after starting to use”（开始使用后最多六周内吃完）。
B 选项 “put in fridge as soon as bring home”（一回家就放冰箱）错误，未开封时只需存放在阴凉干燥处；C 选项 “note the date bought”（记录购买日期）原文未提及，只说 “not after date shown”（不超过标注日期）。

questions.text: DRUM TUTOR All abilities & styles covered Adults only (18+) First lesson costs absolutely nothing when signing up for two months!

options.label: A
options.text: The teacher is offering lessons to anyone interested in trying the drums.

options.label: B
options.text: You must intend to study for a certain period to have the free session.

options.label: C
options.text: To attend these classes, students must already be at a certain level.

questions.explanation:
广告提到 “First lesson costs nothing when signing up for two months”（签约两个月，首课免费），对应 B 选项 “must intend to study for a certain period（two months）to have free session”（必须打算学习一定时长才能获得免费课）。
A 选项 “anyone interested can take lessons”（任何感兴趣的人都可上课）错误，限制 “Adults only (18+)”；C 选项 “must be at a certain level”（必须有一定水平）错误，原文说 “All abilities covered”（涵盖所有水平）。
